integrity: Proof from coefficientwise linear equations plus group-character relation invariant; exhaustive finite tests supplement but do not replace proof. No claim of priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Radical-square-zero finite quiver algebras only; class number and commuting probability, not full class sizes. Nonisomorphism exhibited over prime fields of characteristic at least five. Independent external audit not performed; potential equivalent semidirect-product enumeration in broader literature remains a risk.
title: Commuting probabilities of truncated-quiver unit groups are Fortuin--Kasteleyn evaluations
